title: Three-minute travel pitch
body: Pitch {destination} to the crew in three minutes: one place to see, one thing to eat, one word to learn.
insight: A good pitch makes everyone want to go first.

title: The secret itinerary
body: Plan one perfect half-day in {destination} for the crew, on one page. Present it like a tour guide.
insight: Planning a route teaches you how a city fits together.

title: Myth or fact
body: Bring three surprising claims about {destination}. The crew guesses which ones are true.
insight: Every place has stories that sound made up but aren't.

title: Soundtrack of the trip
body: Pick three songs from {country} or about it, and explain when on the trip each one should play.
insight: Music carries a place's mood better than photos.

title: Bring the table
body: Make or buy one snack from {culture} and tell the crew its story: where it comes from and when people eat it.
insight: Food is the fastest way into a culture.

title: One object
body: Show one object connected to {culture}: something you own, made or borrowed. Explain what it means.
insight: Everyday objects hold a lot of history.

title: Teach us a phrase
body: Teach the crew three phrases from {culture}, with the right gestures, and quiz them at the end.
insight: Language shows what a culture finds worth saying.

title: Then and now
body: Show one photo of {destination} from long ago (or describe it) and one from today. What changed, what didn't?
insight: Places keep their bones even when everything else changes.

title: Street bingo
body: Spot these around {destination} today. Photo for each square.
items: a door painted an unusual colour|a pet on a balcony|a hand-written sign|a street musician|a fruit you can't name|a bicycle with a basket|someone reading outdoors|a mural|a bridge or stairs with a view

title: Market bingo
body: Find these at a market or shopping street in {destination}. Photo for each square.
items: a spice pile|a stack of something round|a price written by hand|a local sweet|a crowd around one stall|something woven|fresh flowers|a scale|a colour you'd never wear

title: Look up bingo
body: Today in {destination}, look up. Photo for each square.
items: a rooftop garden|laundry drying|an old clock|a flag|a bird on a wire|a balcony with plants|a sign in another script|a weather vane or antenna|a cloud shaped like something

title: Food bingo
body: Eat and spot your way through {destination}. Photo for each square.
items: something grilled|something sour|a drink you've never tried|a dish shared by the crew|a dessert|a breakfast food|something wrapped in a leaf or paper|a local bread|the spiciest bite of the day

title: Little things hunt
body: Find and photograph as many as you can in {destination} before the drop closes.
items: the smallest shop you can find|a word you can't pronounce|the oldest-looking building on the street|a view worth a postcard|a local snack under one dollar|a public fountain or tap|a handmade souvenir

title: Colour hunt
body: Find something in each colour in {destination}. One photo per find.

title: Sounds of the city
body: Find the places that make these sounds in {destination}. Photo of each source.
items: bells|water|a crowd cheering|a vendor calling out|birds|music played live|silence

title: Shapes hunt
body: Find these shapes built into {destination}. One photo per find.
items: a perfect circle|a star|an arch|a spiral|a triangle roof|a checkerboard|a heart

title: Phrase sprint
body: Learn how to say thank you in the local language and use it with five different people. First to finish wins.

title: Postcard dash
body: Write a three-line postcard about today and send it (or photograph it). First crew member to finish wins.

title: Local tip race
body: Ask a local for their favourite free thing to do in {destination}. Photo of the place they suggest. First back wins.

title: Sunrise or sunset
body: Catch the next sunrise or sunset in {destination} and photograph it. First photo wins.

title: Forced perspective
body: Take one forced-perspective photo in {destination}: hold up a landmark, shrink a friend, anything goes. The crew votes on the best.

title: The crew in one frame
body: One photo of the whole crew that could only have been taken in {destination}. The crew votes on the best.

title: Album cover
body: Shoot the album cover for this trip in {destination}. Give the album a name. The crew votes on the best.

title: Tiny world
body: Get as close as you can to something small in {destination} and make it look huge. The crew votes on the best.

title: Best bite
body: Rate today's best bite 1–10. Who would you bring back to try it?

title: Lost and found
body: Where did you get lost today, and what did you find?

title: Best seat
body: Best seat you sat in today, and what was the view?

title: Overheard
body: What's one thing you overheard or saw today that you want to remember?

title: Do it again
body: If you could replay one hour of today, which hour and why?

title: Tell a friend
body: Write the text you'd send a friend about today in three lines.

title: Surprise
body: What surprised you most about {destination} today?

title: Small kindness
body: Who was kind to you today and what did they do?

title: Guide tip
body: One tip for the next traveller to {destination}, based only on today.

title: Colour of the day
body: If today were a colour, what colour, and why?

title: Your first stop
body: What would you try first in {destination}?
insight: Your answer helps the crew plan.
choices: Street food|A cooking class|A market walk|A museum

title: Morning or night
body: When do you think {destination} looks best?
insight: Light and crowds change a city completely.

title: Souvenir
body: Which souvenir from {destination} would you actually use?
insight: The best souvenirs get used at home.
choices: Something to eat|Something to wear|Something for the wall|A photo print

title: How to get around
body: How would you rather explore {destination} for a day?
insight: The way you move shapes what you see.
choices: On foot|By bike|By boat or ferry|By local bus or train

title: Say hello
body: How do you say hello in most of the world?
insight: Hello is the first word most travellers learn.
choices: A wave|A handshake|A bow|All of these

title: Set the scene
body: What would make tonight feel most like {culture}?
insight: Small details change the whole mood.
choices: The food|The music|What we wear|The decorations

title: Your pick
body: Which part of {culture} are you most curious about?
choices: Food and drink|Music and dance|Stories and history|Games and sports

title: Time zones
body: How many time zones does the world use today (roughly)?
insight: Some places use half- and quarter-hour offsets.

title: Before you go
body: Look up how people greet each other in {destination}, and try it on the crew today.
insight: Greetings tell you how close people stand and how formal a place is.

title: Money check
body: Find out roughly what a coffee costs in {destination} compared with home.
insight: One everyday price tells you a lot about a place.
